post_slowdown_asr_text: You think I am mad, but I am only nervous. Illness made my senses stronger, especially my hearing. I hear everything in heaven and on earth. Listen, and judge how calmly I tell you this. I loved the old man who lived with me. He never hurt me, and I wanted none of his money, but a cloudy film covered his pale blue eye. That vulture's eye made my blood turn cold. I had to get free of it.
